description.zh: 到期时间，Unix 时间戳格式，单位为毫秒。为空时，默认为永久有效；可设置的最小有效期为1天，最大有效期为3年。
description.en: The expiration time in UNIX timestamp format, in milliseconds. If this parameter is left empty, the client secret is permanently valid. The minimum validity period that you can set is 1 day, and the maximum validity period is 3 years.

title.zh: 创建一个EIAM应用的客户端密钥
title.en: Create a client secret for an EIAM application

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam create-application-client-secret --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --expiration-time 1735530123762 --region cn-hangzhou
